originalTitle: Nowhere to hide: Tech selloff hits software and chip stocks alike
summary: The software and semiconductor sectors haven’t been trading in tandem much this year, but they collectively fell Friday as AI and interest-rate fears hit the market.
content: The software and semiconductor sectors haven’t been trading in tandem much this year, but they collectively fell Friday as AI and interest-rate fears hit the market.
chineseTitle: 无处可藏：科技股遭遇抛售，软件股和芯片股同样受到冲击
chineseSummary: 软件和半导体板块今年并没有太多同步交易，但随着人工智能和利率担忧冲击市场，它们在周五集体下跌。
chineseContent: 软件和半导体板块今年并没有太多同步交易，但随着人工智能和利率担忧冲击市场，它们在周五集体下跌。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
